steps.en: Download the prebuilt binary for your OS, unpack it, put it on PATH
steps.zh: 下载对应系统的预编译二进制，解压，放进 PATH

steps.en: Write a .js script: open a URL, and in the load callback render the page, then exit
steps.zh: 写一个 .js 脚本：打开网址，在加载完的回调里截图，然后退出

steps.en: Run the script with the binary
steps.zh: 用这个二进制运行脚本

steps.en: Loads the page in its bundled WebKit, running its JS and CSS with no window or X11
steps.zh: 用自带的 WebKit 加载页面、执行 JS 和 CSS，不开窗口

steps.en: Fires your callback and writes the PNG, JPEG or PDF file
steps.zh: 触发你的回调，写出 PNG、JPEG 或 PDF 文件

value.en: A screenshot, PDF or scraped DOM value from a real browser engine on a headless server — on a 2018-frozen engine
value.zh: 在无显示器的服务器上用真实浏览器引擎拿到截图、PDF 或 DOM 数据——只是引擎停在 2018 年

sources: https://github.com/ariya/phantomjs#readme (download, unpack; pure headless, no X11 on Linux; development suspended, #15344)
https://phantomjs.org/quick-start.html (phantomjs hello.js; phantom.exit must be called)
https://phantomjs.org/screen-capture.html (require('webpage').create(), page.open, page.render('github.png'), phantomjs github.js; PNG/JPEG/GIF/PDF)
